name: Datasette Charts adds chart annotations, and Datasette Agent can annotate charts itself
title: Datasette Charts adds chart annotations, and Datasette Agent can annotate charts itself
summary: Simon Willison's datasette-charts plugin now supports custom lines, shaded areas and labels on charts, and the Datasette Agent can add those annotations for you; a new gallery site shows every chart type.
